beth-sales: Prospect CISO asks: can you commit to breach notification within 72h for a POC? Also wants any pricing impact for Dedicated/Private. Need a short blurb + SOW language.

sam-sec: We have IR process: detect -> triage -> contain -> eradicate -> recover -> notify -> postmortem. For hosted we aim to ACK high-sev within 4h and provide initial summary within 72h where law requires. Can't promise universal 72h.

dpo-liz: Agree, don't promise absolute 72h. We're a processor in hosted mode; notification duties depend on customer/controller and law. Suggested SOW sentence: "Redwood will acknowledge potential incidents within four (4) hours and provide an initial incident summary within seventy-two (72) hours where legally required; specific obligations governed by the customer agreement and applicable law."

ulia-oncall: For POCs we can enable expanded logging/90d retention and export forensic bundles: `redwoodctl export-logs --customer-id <id> --since 24h --out poc.tar.gz`. We can also snapshot KV caches on request.

mike-finance: No extra fee for standard IR on Hosted. Dedicated/Private include enterprise support; retainers/SLAs quoted separately (typical retainer $10k-$50k).

beth-sales: Great — I'll send that and attach redacted SIG IR answers.
